workflow.name: Web Application Evidence and Program Gate v2
workflow.description: Web-focused scope, architecture, external flow, dual hypothesis runs, root-cause deduplication, independent verification, isolated PoC, exact program eligibility, and relative ranking. Import-valid v2.2: globally unique stage output keys, one consume-all dedup boundary, immutable program extras after dedup, deterministic mapping, high-priority PoC gating, and explicit Web3 fork inputs.

steps.name: Freeze web program scope contract
Map web architecture and trust boundaries
steps.content:
Map in-scope production web/app components, ingress and routing, authentication/session boundaries, APIs, jobs/queues, databases, file/object stores, outbound integrations, secrets/privileged identities, and deployment evidence. Cite construction/configuration/registration paths. Separate repository evidence, supplied deployment facts, and gaps. Return one architecture record; no findings.

Use deterministic enumeration before reasoning: ripgrep plus language-aware AST/compiler tooling when available. Perform {{extra.repeat_runs}} independent enumeration passes when supplied (default: 2), compare their coverage, and record any coverage gap.

steps.name: Map evidenced web entrypoints
steps.content:
Map distinct in-scope production HTTP, GraphQL, RPC, WebSocket, webhook, upload, callback, and externally supplied event entrypoints. Prove route/handler registration and network exposure from supplied evidence. Identify actor, auth requirement, controlled input, state/privilege effect, and candidate accepted impacts. Do not infer live exposure from framework conventions or hostnames. Mark proven/conditional/unproven and preserve gaps.

Use deterministic enumeration before reasoning: ripgrep plus language-aware AST/compiler tooling when available. Perform {{extra.repeat_runs}} independent enumeration passes when supplied (default: 2), compare their coverage, and record any coverage gap.

steps.name: Trace web security flows
steps.content: Trace one materially distinct production flow from {{surface_entrypoint_label}} through ingress/proxy assumptions, parsing/canonicalization, authentication/session/CSRF, authorization, validation, business logic, database/queue, outbound request, file/process/parser, and terminal effect. Capture async/retry/transaction/partial-failure behavior and what remains attacker-controlled at the sink. Return ordered path:line:symbol evidence. No findings.

steps.name: Web hypotheses A: identity, injection, trust boundaries
steps.content: Fresh-context hypothesis run for {{flow_flow_summary}}. Emit only code-grounded hypotheses relevant to this flow: auth/session bypass, object/tenant authorization, confused deputy, injection/unsafe interpretation, SSRF/URL confusion, path/file access, upload/parser/deserialization, request smuggling assumptions, secret/data disclosure, and trust-boundary failures. One root cause per record with precise actor sequence, locations, guards, falsification target, and accepted-impact candidate.

steps.name: Web hypotheses B: workflow, concurrency, asymmetry
steps.content: Independent fresh-context run for {{flow_flow_summary}}. Examine state-machine abuse, replay/idempotency, race/TOCTOU, partial rollback, cache/policy mismatch, alternate content types/routes, callback/retry effects, and bounded computational or state amplification. Require a specific root cause and non-volume-dependent effect for availability claims. Include exact verification locations and falsification target.

steps.name: Deduplicate web root causes
steps.content: Cluster {{multi_output_depth_4}} by faulty operation/missing guard, attacker primitive, invariant, effect, and fix. Generate stable fingerprints, preserve all trigger paths and gaps, and prioritize evidence-rich candidates. Remove duplicates, unsupported deployment assumptions, scanner-only observations, volume-only DDoS, and hardening items.

steps.name: Independent web exploitability verification
steps.content: As a separate verifier, try to kill {{dedup_canonical_hypothesis_id}}. Re-read each location and prove network/production reachability, input control after every normalization, authentication/session state, authorization, framework/proxy behavior, database constraints, async/downstream checks, and concrete terminal effect. Label provenance for every fact. supported requires the complete path under supplied configuration; falsified means a mandatory code fact blocks it; blocked means live ingress/deployment/identity/capacity evidence is required. Provide a safe isolated reproduction plan.

steps.name: Deterministic web PoC gate
steps.content:
Execute the smallest safe authorized reproduction against a local/isolated deployment pinned to {{commit_sha}}, using integration tests or a minimal request/event sequence. Record setup, identities, exact requests, before/after state, response/log/trace, and repeatability. Availability PoCs must use bounded traffic and demonstrate meaningful effect without prohibited load. Never test a live target destructively. Return PoC verdict and evidence.

Cost gate: if {{dedup_triage_priority}} is not `high`, do not build or run a harness. Return poc_verdict=`skipped_by_priority` with the reason. For smart-contract candidates, use {{extra.fork_rpc_url}} and {{extra.fork_block}} when supplied.

steps.name: Apply exact program gate
steps.content:
Apply the immutable program scope contract to this technically verified candidate.
Program evidence is read directly from immutable extras after dedup: snapshot={{extra.program_rules_snapshot}}; checked_at={{extra.program_rules_checked_at}}; URL={{extra.bug_bounty_url}}; deployment={{extra.deployment_evidence}}; known_issues={{extra.known_issues_snapshot}}; testing_constraints={{extra.authorized_test_constraints}}.
Candidate: {{dedup_canonical_summary}}. Root cause: {{dedup_canonical_root_cause}} at {{dedup_canonical_location}}.
Technical verdict: {{verify_technical_verdict}}. Production reachability: {{verify_production_reachability}}.
Observed effect: {{poc_observed_effect}}. Reproduction verdict: {{poc_poc_verdict}}. Reproduction evidence: {{poc_poc_evidence}}.

Set eligibility_verdict=eligible only when the exact affected asset is in scope, the observed effect matches a named accepted impact, no exclusion or known-issue rule controls, and required deployment facts are evidenced. Use ineligible for a controlling exclusion or absent impact; use blocked for missing program/deployment facts. Assign severity only from the supplied program language and measured impact. Do not use popularity, theoretical TVL, scanner confidence, or remembered platform conventions.

steps.name: Report supported eligible web finding
